tasks.title: Add Indian-specific sources to planner
tasks.description: Add TeamBlind, Levels.fyi, and Naukri to the planner's query generation alongside existing Glassdoor, AmbitionBox, Reddit. Bump initial query count from 9 to 11.

tasks.title: Replace Ollama embeddings with fastembed
tasks.description: Swap ollama.AsyncClient embeddings for fastembed (pure Python, no server needed). Eliminates the Ollama-must-be-running requirement entirely since it's only used for embeddings.

tasks.title: Add data freshness to sources
tasks.description: Extract and store publish/update date of each scraped page. Surface a date range like 'sources from 2024–25' in the report so users can judge recency.

tasks.title: Show confidence indicator in report
tasks.description: Add 'Based on X sources across Y search iterations' to the report header so users know how much data backs the verdict.

tasks.title: Detailed progress messages during search
tasks.description: Instead of generic node names, emit what's actually being searched — e.g. 'Searching glassdoor.co.in for napses technologies salary'. Stream these via the existing SSE progress events.

tasks.title: Vitals color coding
tasks.description: Color-code the Glassdoor rating vital: green >3.8, yellow 3.0–3.8, red <3.0. Parse the rating value out of the vitals and apply the color to the vitalValue span.

tasks.title: Report history via localStorage
tasks.description: Save each completed report to localStorage keyed by company name + timestamp. Show a collapsible history panel so users can revisit past reports without re-running.

tasks.title: Fix mobile layout
tasks.description: Audit and fix responsive layout below 400px. Vitals row, flags grid, and header are likely broken on small screens.

tasks.title: ChromaDB session cleanup on startup
tasks.description: On backend startup, delete ChromaDB collections older than 7 days to prevent unbounded disk growth. Each research session creates a new collection that is never cleaned up.

tasks.title: SearXNG fallback to DuckDuckGo
tasks.description: If SearXNG returns zero results or is unreachable, fall back to DuckDuckGo HTML scraping so the app doesn't silently fail when Docker isn't running.
